notes: «وقد روي هذا» is a passive opening: no transmitter is named before أيوب (rule 10)
«حدثنا بذلك» starts a second isnad for the same hadith: a second group; it ends with «بهذا», a back reference to the route it repeats
The text's «عن النبي» ends the first route: the Prophet is not a link (rule 12)
